LanguageData.CQF_AI_MessageTooLarge: A single AI message or tool result exceeds the size limit. Read a smaller page or reduce the size of one batch.
LanguageData.CQF_AI_ResponseTooLarge: The API response exceeds the local size limit. Reduce the size of one reply or tool batch.

LanguageData.CQF_AI_NativeToolsHint: Use structured function calls when supported by the configured model and API. Disable this option for XML tool transport on compatible APIs without function calling.
LanguageData.CQF_AI_PortalLinked: This portal is already linked. Its destination and exit name must be changed together with its runtime counterpart.
LanguageData.CQF_AI_ReadTooLarge: The requested data is too large. Read a narrower field path or use a smaller page.
LanguageData.CQF_AI_ToolLimit: This batch of map changes exceeds operation capacity. Split it into smaller batches. Applied changes remain visible and can be undone.
LanguageData.CQF_AI_ToolRetrying: Tool operation rejected; asking AI to correct it (round {0})…
LanguageData.CQF_AI_RollbackMismatch: The edit failed and its original state could not be fully restored. Check the current editor content and error log.
LanguageData.CQF_AI_UsageDetails: Current task: input {0}, output {1}; {2} responses without valid usage. Conversation: input {3}, output {4}; {5} responses without valid usage. Counts come from the API and include completed tool rounds. +? means the total is incomplete. Missing usage is not counted as zero. Cancelled requests may be billed without returning usage. Clearing chat resets these counters.
LanguageData.CQF_AI_InvalidUsage: The API returned invalid token usage. The reply remains available; this response is marked as missing usage.
LanguageData.CQF_AI_UsageEmpty: Open the AI chat to view this conversation's usage.
LanguageData.CQF_AI_ElapsedHint: Total elapsed time includes waiting for AI replies across every tool round and executing tools. Each operation's execution time measures only the local tool, excluding AI and network waits.
LanguageData.CQF_AI_ActivityHint: Expand or collapse reasoning information and executed operations.
LanguageData.CQF_AI_Reasoning: Reasoning information provided by the API
LanguageData.CQF_AI_ReasoningUnavailable: The API has not provided reasoning information. The current stage and elapsed time are shown above.
LanguageData.CQF_AI_ReasoningAvailable: Reasoning information received. Expand to view.
LanguageData.CQF_AI_InvalidStream: The API returned an invalid stream. Incomplete operations were not executed.
LanguageData.CQF_AI_StreamError: The API reported a streaming error. Incomplete operations were not executed.
LanguageData.CQF_AI_PreviewExcerpt: Live preview shortened; the full reply will appear when complete.

LanguageData.CQF_AI_InvalidHistory: The conversation file is invalid. The original file has been preserved.
LanguageData.CQF_AI_HistoryTooLarge: This conversation is too large to save. Start a new conversation; the last saved file has been preserved.
LanguageData.CQF_AI_MissingTarget: The object is no longer available. Query the available objects again before continuing.
LanguageData.CQF_AI_DefinitionNameFixed: Changing a loaded definition's defName is unsupported. Edit its contents using the existing name.
LanguageData.CQF_AI_AdditionalPromptHint: Optional instructions, up to 16,000 characters. Disabled by default; disabled or empty text is not sent to AI. Applies to the next request and its tool rounds. Edit freely for layout, writing style, or other preferences.
LanguageData.CQF_AI_LayoutPromptText: When I ask for a village or settlement, first plan a connected layout at the requested scale: a central gathering space, circulation paths, distinct functional buildings, and suitable furniture. Vary building dimensions and entrances according to their use and local terrain rather than placing only repeated empty rectangles. Leave traversable paths between entrances, keep doors clear, face chairs toward table edges, and reserve access beside beds and at workstations. Preserve unrelated existing objects. Query needed definitions once and reuse their placement metadata. Apply manageable batches, then inspect the affected region; follow pagination until relevant doors, furniture and operating cells are actually read. Correct orientation or obstruction issues before finishing.
LanguageData.CQF_AI_ReplacePromptConfirm: Replace the current additional instructions with the settlement layout example?
LanguageData.CQF_AI_PromptTooLong: Additional instructions exceed 16,000 characters. Shorten the text in AI settings before sending.
LanguageData.CQF_AI_IdleTimeoutHint: Stop only after this many seconds without incoming feedback. Reply, reasoning and tool-argument fragments, and stream heartbeats reset the timer. A request may run longer than this limit while feedback continues.
LanguageData.CQF_AI_LiveMapOverlap: Placements in this batch overlap. The AI can adjust their positions or rotations using the conflict details.
LanguageData.CQF_AI_PlanningHint: Complex tasks can maintain goals, acceptance criteria and plans saved with the chat. Restored tasks do not run automatically; send a message to continue or revise them.
LanguageData.CQF_AI_AgentsHint: Requires goals and plans. The AI decides when to delegate. Workers inspect and propose; the main agent applies changes. Additional requests increase usage.
LanguageData.CQF_AI_AgentModelHint: Leave blank to use the main model. Workers share the configured endpoint and API key. The provider must support the chosen model.
LanguageData.CQF_AI_AgentPromptHint: Optional; blank adds no preferences. Sent only to workers. Add design, research or review preferences here. Inspection permissions are enforced by the application.
LanguageData.CQF_AI_SteerHint: Add instructions to the current task. Ctrl + Enter sends. With an empty input, this button stops the task.
LanguageData.CQF_AI_Steering: Additional instructions received; the task will be revised in the next round.
LanguageData.CQF_AI_InvalidPlan: Invalid goal or plan. Check step IDs, dependencies and completion evidence.
LanguageData.CQF_AI_TaskUnfinished: The task is unfinished. Complete the plan, collect worker results and read actual state after changes.
LanguageData.CQF_AI_InvalidAgent: Invalid worker assignment or permission configuration.
LanguageData.CQF_AI_AgentCapacity: Worker record capacity reached for this task. Reuse existing results or continue with the main agent.
LanguageData.CQF_AI_AgentResultTooLarge: The worker result is too large. Narrow the assignment and return a concise result.
LanguageData.CQF_AI_AgentDetailsHint: Click to expand or collapse the assignment, live progress and result.
LanguageData.CQF_AI_RuntimeFailed: The game reported an error while executing this operation. Some effects may already have occurred; inspect the current state before continuing.
LanguageData.CQF_AI_UndoUnsupported: This task executed operations that cannot be fully undone.
LanguageData.CQF_AI_ExecutionSpeedHint: Map changes execute in order on UI frames, including while paused. Slow: one change per 100 ms; normal: up to eight per 50 ms; fast: up to 48 per frame; finish mode: a six ms frame budget. Stop keeps completed changes. Task undo checks for conflicts before restoring.
LanguageData.CQF_AI_BudgetHint: Defaults: 100,000 tokens and 24 requests shared by the main AI and all workers. Each HTTP attempt counts, including compatibility retries. A task pauses before a request would exceed the estimated remaining budget. Completed changes remain applied; send a new instruction to continue with a new budget. Updated limits apply to the next task. Token reservations are estimates; provider usage is settled after each response, so an in-flight response can exceed the token limit. This is not a currency spending cap.
LanguageData.CQF_AI_BudgetPaused: Task paused at its shared request/token budget. Completed changes remain applied. Send a new instruction to continue with a new budget.
LanguageData.CQF_AI_BudgetEstimated: Budget accounting includes estimated usage for requests with unavailable usage or interrupted responses. Reported token totals above remain unchanged.
